summary: A brand workspace: pick a brand, then work on its websites, search ranking, content, social, local listings and outreach. Roll-ups, research tools and connections sit outside any one brand.

brandSwitcher.note: Shows the picked brand (name from /marketing/[brandId]); every "brand" section below uses that brand. With no brand picked, only the Brands section and the cross-brand sections show.

sections.name: Brands
sections.why: Every brand, add one, and the cross-brand hub.

sections.name: Overview
sections.why: One brand at a glance: properties, health, activity, inbox.

sections.name: Websites
sections.why: The brand's sites: pages, structure, sitemaps, crawls, media, settings.

sections.name: SEO
sections.why: Search work on a site: audit, keywords, rankings, backlinks, search console, AI visibility.

sections.name: Content
sections.why: What to write and publish: content plans and topical maps.

sections.name: Social
sections.why: The brand's accounts, look-ups, outliers, swipe file, video studio, ad library.

sections.name: Local & Listings
sections.why: Business locations, listings, reviews and the local rank grid.

sections.name: Press, Email & Ads
sections.why: Outreach: press room, email, advertising, PR calendar and initiatives.

sections.name: Competitors & Reputation
sections.why: Who else is out there, what is said about the brand, news monitors, what AI says.

sections.name: Brand
sections.why: Who the brand is: voice, strategy, audience, claims, media, products.

sections.name: Reports
sections.why: Roll-ups across all brands: reports, cost, ranks, search console, social.

sections.name: Research tools
sections.why: Free analyzers and research for any site, plus the zip-code heatmap.

sections.name: Operations
sections.why: Connect Google and Bing, automations, approvals, capabilities, data quality.

sections.name: Publish
sections.why: Websites we publish: CMS, HTML pages, artifacts, podcasts.

buried.why: Marketing > Brands > pick a brand > Websites. The menu opens on the brands list and Websites only appears after a brand is picked.
buried.proposal: Make Websites the first section under the brand switcher; with one brand, skip the list and land on it.

buried.why: A site is reached through brand, then Websites, then the site; no cross-brand site list exists (the old one was removed).
buried.proposal: Add an "All websites" view in the Brands section, filterable by brand.

buried.why: SEO first asks for a brand, then a site, then shows the tools.
buried.proposal: Remember the last site per brand; open straight onto it.

buried.why: Google and Bing must be connected before any ranking or search data shows, yet the link sits in the Operations group at the bottom.
buried.proposal: Show a "Connect Google" prompt on the brand overview and SEO pages until done.

buried.why: Voice, strategy, claims and audience hide behind a card grid on the Identity page.
buried.proposal: List the identity rooms as sidebar children of Brand.

buried.why: The main keyword tool is brand > SEO > site > Keywords > Workbench.
buried.proposal: Put Keywords as a direct sidebar row of the site SEO menu with Workbench as its default tab.

buried.why: The video studio is a tab on Social, with create/formats only inside it.
buried.proposal: Keep, but add a "New video" button on the Social overview.

missingFromTree.name: Websites
missingFromTree.why: TREE.md lists "hub, brands, SEO, search console, social, CMS & pages, podcasts, artifacts, reports, automations, approvals, research, heatmap" with no Websites. It is the brand's main asset and the base of SEO.

missingFromTree.name: Content
missingFromTree.why: Content plans and topical maps are a core marketing job; TREE only has CMS & pages.

missingFromTree.name: Local & Listings
missingFromTree.why: Locations, Google Business Profiles, reviews and the local rank grid are not in TREE.

missingFromTree.name: Press, Email & Ads
missingFromTree.why: PR, outreach, email and advertising have routes (some Coming Soon) but no TREE entry.

missingFromTree.name: Competitors & Reputation
missingFromTree.why: Competitors, news monitoring, AI visibility and reputation are not in TREE.

missingFromTree.name: Brand (identity)
missingFromTree.why: Voice, strategy, audience and claims are not in TREE.

missingFromTree.name: Connections
missingFromTree.why: Google/Bing connection is the gate to rankings; TREE lists automations and approvals but not connections, capabilities or data quality.

missingFromTree.name: Brand switcher
missingFromTree.why: The brand-first model is not in TREE.
